address: Barlaeus Gymnasium, Weteringschans 31, Amsterdam (1866 Neo-Renaissance school, Singelgracht side behind)
notes: Barlaeus Gymnasium, Weteringschans 31 (pand 0363100012169564, built 1866, 65 LoD2.2 surfaces, roof max 25.4 m). Street front (SW, surfaces 31 centre, 29 and 44 wings; 2021-09-09 and 2025-07-14 panoramas): stucco ground storey, two round-headed storeys with polychrome (brick and stone alternating) voussoir arches, a square-headed attic storey of triple windows; centre bay has a round-headed portal, a first-floor balcony with a white balustrade and BARLAEUS / GYMNASIUM in gilt capitals either side of the door. Canal front (NE, surfaces 48/55; 2021-01-22): ten bays, stucco ground with small windows, three brick storeys of sashes, an attic row of triple windows in white-framed bays.

MODELLED: stucco ground (stoneStoreys [0]), round-headed windows on storeys 1 and 2 only (new arches.storeys), voussoir arch bands, balcony over the centre bay only (new balconies.bays), stone portal with the lettering on its frieze, cornice. SIMPLIFIED: BARLAEUS GYMNASIUM is one lettering on the portal frieze, not two words either side of the door; the attic triple windows are three single windows per bay; the canal front is plain sashes; the 3DBAG roof is flat bitumen over the mansard slate. SKIPPED: wrought-iron area railings and street furniture (temporary / too thin), polychrome string bands between the arched storeys (below the component), the unphotographed courtyard and rear walls (blank otherWalls).
